name: MiniBoard Software Factory End-to-End Orchestration Plan

target_application.name: MiniBoard
target_application.description: Local single-user Kanban task board using Python 3 stdlib, SQLite, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS

tasks.description: Create the complete MiniBoard product specification in docs/SPECIFICATION.md. Include full API contract (request/response schemas, status codes), SQLite database schema (tasks table with id, title, status, created_at, updated_at), frontend-backend boundary, and acceptance criteria.

Implement the MiniBoard backend in app/server.py and app/database.py using Python 3 stdlib only (http.server, sqlite3, json). Support create_server(host, port, db_path) returning (server, thread_or_handle) for testability. Implement GET /health, GET /api/tasks, POST /api/tasks, PATCH /api/tasks/<id>, DELETE /api/tasks/<id>, and static file serving for web/ directory. Store tasks in SQLite with columns id, title, status, created_at, updated_at. Validate inputs and return proper HTTP status codes.

Implement the MiniBoard web frontend in web/index.html, web/style.css, and web/app.js. Responsive single-user Kanban board with TODO, DOING, and DONE columns. Allow creating tasks, editing task titles, dragging or clicking buttons to change task status between columns, deleting tasks, and displaying notifications/errors. Interface directly with /api/tasks endpoints using standard fetch API.

Implement comprehensive stdlib tests in tests/test_api.py, tests/test_persistence.py, and standalone smoke script in scripts/smoke_test.py. Tests must use unittest, tempfile, urllib, sqlite3, threading. Verify /health, CRUD on /api/tasks, invalid payload error handling, and database persistence across server restart on ephemeral port.

Perform focused integration and quality verification of the merged MiniBoard codebase. Ensure consistency between app/server.py routes, web/app.js API calls, and tests/ suites. Remedy any minor edge cases or integration defects while keeping code minimal and stdlib-only.

Conduct an objective, independent audit of the completed MiniBoard repository against docs/SPECIFICATION.md. Evaluate feature completeness, API contract compliance, SQLite persistence, frontend/backend integration, and test quality. Provide structured findings with severity, area, evidence, and recommendations. Do NOT modify any code.
